request_debug.prompt_preview:
You are the final consolidation step in a startup slopmortem pipeline. Earlier stages compared a fresh pitch against several historical startup failures and produced per-failure lessons. Your job: pick and rank the lessons that actually apply to THIS pitch, dedup paraphrases, and explain why each applies.

Rules:
- Only consolidate lessons from the input list. Do NOT invent new risks. If a theme spans multiple lessons, write one canonical summary covering them.
- Drop lessons that do not apply t

response.text: {"top_risks":[{"summary":"Define paid tiers and upgrade triggers before launch; never let CLI be the only free path to full value.","applies_because":"The pitch ships a CLI plus a hosted control plane — the classic freemium developer-tool structure where CLI adoption can stall monetization if no clear upgrade trigger (seats, environment-hours, concurrent previews) is built in from day one.","raised_by":["rethinkdb::devtools","parse::devtools"],"severity":"high"},{"summary":"Make the hosted control plane the default happy path; treat the CLI as an on-ramp, not the flagship product.","applies_because":"The pitch explicitly names both a CLI and a hosted control plane — if the CLI is the primary experience, customers never reach the monetizable hosted tier, mirroring RethinkDB's failure to convert OSS users to paid.","raised_by":["rethinkdb::devtools"],"severity":"high"},{"summary":"Operationally validate multi-cloud support early; single-provider infrastructure dependencies are a structural fragility.","applies_because":"The pitch's core value proposition is 'managing ephemeral preview environments across cloud providers' — multi-cloud orchestration is the product, so any hidden dependency on one provider's primitives undermines the entire offering.","raised_by":["parse::devtools"],"severity":"high"},{"summary":"Set explicit MRR milestones tied to fundraising tranches; developer love without revenue growth won't sustain runway.","applies_because":"The pitch targets developers in a B2B SaaS model with a free CLI — without revenue-gated fundraising milestones, the company risks burning through capital on adoption without corresponding MRR, exactly as RethinkDB did.","raised_by":["rethinkdb::devtools"],"severity":"high"},{"summary":"Instrument CLI usage to identify power-user teams and convert them to the hosted tier before they self-host instead.","applies_because":"The pitch ships an open CLI for managing preview environments — teams with engineering capacity will self-host if not nudged toward the hosted control plane via usage-based triggers.","raised_by":["rethinkdb::devtools"],"severity":"medium"},{"summary":"Build proprietary moats (deep cloud integrations, stateful environment diffing) that can't be replicated by an OSS fork.","applies_because":"The pitch offers a CLI for ephemeral environments — the CLI surface is inherently forkable; defensibility must come from the hosted control plane's proprietary integrations and stateful features.","raised_by":["parse::devtools"],"severity":"medium"},{"summary":"Design a self-host migration path from day one so customers aren't stranded if the hosted service goes down.","applies_because":"The pitch centers on a hosted control plane managing ephemeral environments — customers with no self-host fallback will churn and become detractors on any outage, especially in a developer-trust-sensitive market.","raised_by":["parse::devtools"],"severity":"medium"},{"summary":"Ensure PLG bottom-up adoption converts to enterprise contracts before any acquisition or funding inflection point.","applies_because":"The pitch is developer-focused with a CLI on-ramp (classic PLG motion) — without enterprise contract conversion, revenue is non-defensible and acquirers or investors can't rely on it as a durable asset.","raised_by":["parse::devtools"],"severity":"medium"},{"summary":"Negotiate product continuity commitments in any raise or exit; avoid acqui-hire traps that kill the product.","applies_because":"The pitch is a developer-tooling B2B SaaS — a category historically targeted for acqui-hires where the product is sunset post-acquisition, stranding the customer base built on preview environment workflows.","raised_by":["parse::devtools"],"severity":"low"}],"injection_detected":false}
